rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for someone naive or lacking real-world sophistication.

example.english: They are so unworldly that they do not even realise they have been cheated.
example.traditional: 佢咁大個人仲唔識世故，畀人呃咗都唔知。
example.jyutping: keoi5 gam3 daai6 go3 jan4 zung6 m4 sik1 sai3 gu3 bei2 jan4 ngaak1 zo2 dou1 m4 zi1

rows.note: Use this when the person is detached from worldly concerns in a spiritual or religious sense, rather than merely inexperienced.

example.english: They are spiritually unworldly and care little about fame or fortune.
example.traditional: 佢一心修行，對名利好出世。
example.jyutping: keoi5 jat1 sam1 sau1 hang4 deoi3 ming4 lei6 hou2 ceot1 sai3
